session.summary: Planning for a Substack publication focused on urban balcony gardening, covering content strategy, publishing cadence, monetization plans, and outreach approaches.

records.content: Create and launch a Substack publication focused on urban balcony gardening to share personal experiences, tips, and techniques for growing vegetables in small apartment spaces.

details.title: Urban Balcony Gardening Substack Launch
details.notes: This project combines passion for gardening with content creation, potentially developing into a modest income stream while documenting gardening experiences.
details.completion_criteria: Successfully launch Substack with initial free content and establish regular publishing schedule
details.maintenance_requirements: Regular content creation and community engagement

project.goal: Launch and establish an urban balcony gardening Substack with regular content

records.content: Develop initial content strategy for free Substack posts focusing on basic urban gardening topics: containers, soil selection, and plant recommendations for small spaces.

details.title: Balcony Gardening Content Strategy
details.notes: Start with fundamentals that will help beginners get started with minimal space and resources. Document your own setup with photos to demonstrate real-world applications.
details.completion_criteria: Content calendar with at least 8 weeks of planned topics, with the first 3 articles fully outlined

project.goal: Create a comprehensive content strategy for initial Substack launch

records.content: Photograph current balcony garden setup to create a visual portfolio showcasing what's possible in small spaces, to use as supporting content for Substack articles.

details.title: Balcony Garden Photography Session
details.notes: Take high-quality photos during optimal lighting times. Include wide shots of the entire setup as well as close-ups of specific plants, containers, and growing solutions. Document both successes and challenges.
details.completion_criteria: Collection of 20+ high-quality photos organized by category (setup, plants, solutions, etc.)

project.goal: Create visual documentation of balcony garden for Substack content

records.content: Develop a monetization strategy for the Substack with a free tier for basic content and a paid subscription tier offering premium content including detailed guides and personalized gardening advice.

details.title: Substack Monetization Plan
details.notes: Focus on building value and audience first before implementing paid tier. Consider what exclusive content would be most valuable to subscribers and what pricing would be appropriate for the value offered.
details.completion_criteria: Defined free vs. paid content strategy, pricing model, and timeline for implementing paid subscriptions

project.goal: Create sustainable monetization strategy for balcony gardening Substack

records.content: Create a promotion strategy to announce the Substack launch to friends and social media followers, emphasizing authentic sharing of personal gardening experiences.

details.title: Substack Promotion Strategy
details.notes: Keep messaging authentic and focused on passion for urban gardening rather than coming across as overly promotional. Consider creating shareable graphics or photos that showcase both your garden and the Substack.
details.completion_criteria: Complete promotion plan with announcement templates for different platforms and a timeline for initial outreach

project.goal: Develop effective, authentic promotion plan for Substack launch

records.content: Establish a weekly publishing schedule for Substack posts with seasonal gardening tips that align with the current growing calendar.

details.title: Substack Weekly Publishing Schedule
details.notes: Align content with the natural gardening calendar to ensure posts are relevant and timely. Buffer some evergreen content for weeks when you might be too busy to create new content.
details.completion_criteria: 12-week rolling content calendar with specific topics assigned to each week

project.goal: Create sustainable publishing schedule aligned with seasonal gardening needs

records.content: Explore potential future collaborations with other urban gardening enthusiasts to expand content offerings and reach a wider audience.

details.title: Urban Gardening Collaboration Opportunities
details.notes: Consider guest posts, interviews, or co-created content with other gardeners who have different specialties or growing conditions. This could add diversity to content while reducing individual content creation burden.

records.content: Contents.md file for organizing the Urban Balcony Gardening Substack project, providing an overview of all related files and components.

details.title: _Contents.md
details.notes: Central organizational document that links all project components together for easy navigation
details.maintenance_requirements: Update with any new components as project evolves

project.goal: Organize all project components for easy navigation

records.content: Tasks.md file for consolidating all actionable items related to the Urban Balcony Gardening Substack project, tracking priorities and status.

details.title: _Tasks.md
details.notes: Central task tracking document that compiles all actionable items from across the project components
details.maintenance_requirements: Regularly update task status and add new tasks as they emerge

project.goal: Centrally track all project tasks and their status
